item.title: One unusual tooth suggests Homo erectus shared southern China with another human species
item.description: [Open Source Software] Keyword: FOSS — One of the most important ancestors to humans was around for much longer than previously believed. item.title: Who's to blame for a rogue AI? New legal framework maps accountability
item.description: [AI & Automation] Keyword: AI agent — Cyberattacks and other harms caused by artificial intelligence challenge the ability of laws to determine who is liable. Product liability law would point to the company that built the AI model, but AIs are trained on data the company didn't produce, and the legions of people who have used them also played a role. Free speech and social media immunity laws that treat an AI agent as responsible for its own actions could imply the AI agent deserves the same rights as a person.
